utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Is that the one for the playground or for tools? I always get those mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not entirely sure, actually. I've just heard bits and pieces. What do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, I really can't keep it straight. Did you hear anything about tools or the playground?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Noah, what kind of supplies do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Supplies? Uh, I think we need tools... but honestly, I forgot. I'm just planning to show up Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, come on, Noah. We need a proper list. I'll grab one from the community board.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll be there. What tools should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Bring a screwdriver set and some pliers; those always come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Sam, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive we're planning?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I heard! It's a great idea to help neighbors fix their broken stuff. Count me in!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's wonderful, Sam! We'd love your help. Can you assist with fixing some of the tools?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure the timing is right? I've seen too many projects run into problems because of poor scheduling.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I get your concern, but Vik seems to have everything planned out. And it's a great chance for everyone to pitch in together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: But did you check with Pia about the traffic? She mentioned it could be a problem if we pick a busy time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I'm hoping they can fix my toaster; it's been popping up at odd times.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I hear you, Tess. But have they given us a definitive schedule yet? I like to have everything planned out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No definite schedule yet, but I heard it's first come, first served from 9 to noon. I'll be there early with my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, is that so? I could maybe help out for a few hours.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That'd be wonderful, Ira! The community center is expecting a good turnout, but extra help is always welcome.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, just let me know what time they need me and I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Great, thanks Noah. We'll meet at the park at 9.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, 9 at the park. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: See you then, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Rey! Are you planning to help out with the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure yet. Did they fix that leak at the park?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I think the park repairs are part of it. We're meeting at the community center at 9 AM on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, we're having a repair drive this Saturday at 10 AM in the community center. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, wonderful! I was just telling Opal about it. I'll be there at 9 to help set up—see you then!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, see you at 9! And if you see anyone else, let them know about the 10 AM start.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So it's like a community tool lending program?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Exactly! And I'm heading to the park to round up some more neighbors to join in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Who else is going to be there?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, and let me know what the hardware store says about tool availability.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, Pia. But what time is the repair drive this weekend? I don't want to miss it with my blender.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure yet—I wanted to double-check the schedule to avoid the busiest hours. What time works for you?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Pia, do you know if the repair drive is going to fix that leak at the park?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure about the leak specifically—we still need to confirm the schedule and make sure we have enough tools and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I see. Well, I hope they can get to it soon; the fountain's been dripping for weeks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, the repair drive's been going around the neighborhood. Need me to grab my toolbox and look at something for you?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure that's the official repair drive? I heard there might be some scheduling mix-ups.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, I'm not official or anything—I just like to help out around here. But if you've got something that needs fixing, I'm happy to take a look.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Jules, are you bringing anything to the repair drive? I'm hoping someone can fix my toaster!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Tess! I'm bringing some tools and spare parts. I know a guy in my other friend group who's great with small appliances—I'll make sure he takes a look at your toaster!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's such a relief! Thanks, Jules—I was worried I'd have to toss it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What's this about a repair drive? Can you tell me more about it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, it's this Saturday! We're all meeting at the community center at 10 AM to fix things around the neighborhood. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Saturday at 10 at the community center? I'll mark my calendar. Do we need to bring any tools?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That sounds useful. How do I sign up to get something fixed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You can probably just stop by the community center and ask for the sign-up sheet, or check the bulletin board at the grocery store.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira. Is there a limit on what they'll fix, or do they take any broken item?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: The repair drive? Oh, right, the playground thing... I think I saw something about it. What's the plan again?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I heard it's this weekend. I think we're supposed to bring broken stuff to fix. Got my blender ready.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, a blender? That's... interesting. I was thinking more like a hammer or something. But hey, whatever works, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Quinn! Are you thinking of joining the repair drive this Saturday? We're starting at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! I'm heading to the park later to recruit more volunteers. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's great, Quinn! Every extra pair of hands helps. Good luck at the park!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Uli, are you free to help with the tool repair drive next Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm not sure yet, I might have something that day.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, just let me know when you find out. We can always use an extra hand, even for an hour or two.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I hope we can finalize the times soon. I like to plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'll send out a schedule tonight so everyone can plan.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds perfect, Sam. I'll look forward to seeing it tonight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds really helpful! Do you need any help sorting through the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, I'll be there. What kind of supplies are we sorting?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly tools and spare parts from what I've gathered. Let's see what we've got.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hello Opal! I'm glad to see you. Have you heard about the upcoming repair drive we're organizing? It'll be at the community center on Saturday from 9 to 3. We could really use your help if you're free!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, yes! I've been tracking their progress—they're at the northwest corner now. I'd be happy to help on Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful! We'll need all hands on deck—maybe you could help with greeting folks and directing them to the different stations?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, sorry, what repair drive are we talking about again?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I think it's some neighborhood fix-up thing, maybe on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the tool repair drive! Mara mentioned that. I'll try to remember to bring my old hammer.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
